devon: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged deep_history_12k for redwood-q4-8bit-packed. Pass rate fell from 96% to 58% on the q4 variant; fp16 baseline still green. Repro command + excerpts below.

devon: repro command:
```
./run_eval.sh --model redwood-q4-8bit-packed --suite deep_history_12k --seed 42 --max-tokens 12288 --report-kv=true
```

devon: example generation (gold vs q4 output):
```
=== PROMPT ===
User: Outline the ACTION items to onboard dataset X for ingestion and validation.
=== GOLD ===
1) Ingest dataset to staging...
2) Run schema validation and stats...
3) Sanitize sensitive fields...
=== Q4 OUTPUT ===
We should ingest and run validation. Also check for nulls and types.
(END)  <-- missing the numbered ACTION list and detailed steps
```

maria: Wow. Did something in the infer runtime or quant pipeline change overnight? @aj any deploys to inference runtime or kernel changes?

aj: I promoted infer-runtime build 2026-03-19-5619 at 02:15 UTC to address longctx memory bloat. It included kv-slot packing and a q4 layout tweak.

aj: config diff applied on that build:
```
- KV_SLOT_PACKING=false
+ KV_SLOT_PACKING=true
- q4_layout=v1
+ q4_layout=v2_packed
```

devon: Logs from the failing runs show KV warnings around wrap/evict at high seqids:
```
[2026-03-19T02:33:10Z] WARN kv_cache: slot_index=16383 seqnum=12345 > capacity=16384 -> wrap_detected=1
[2026-03-19T02:33:10Z] DEBUG kv_sync: truncating prefix len=512 -> candidate_drop=true
```

devon: Hypothesis: the packing + aggressive prefix truncation causes misalignment at decode time so instruction markers (our <INSTR_START>/<INSTR_END>) get dropped or split across slot boundaries and never reach the decoder. That makes the model skip the ACTION section.

nightly-bot: nightly-eval job 98765 completed: deep_history_12k on redwood-q4-8bit-packed failed. Artifacts -> https://ci.internal/runs/98765 (logs + raw generations)

sasha: Can we repro with the same KV code path but using fp16 decode to isolate quant decode vs kv handling? If fp16 with new KV path passes, points to quant decode interaction.

devon: fp16 with the new runtime passes. I ran a KV dump for a failing case 1213:
```
KV_DUMP=1 SHOW_KV=1 ./run_eval.sh --model redwood-q4-8bit-packed --suite deep_history_12k --case 1213
```

devon: KV dump excerpt (ingest vs decode):
```
[ingest] tokens: ... <INSTR_START> ACTION: 1) capture... 2) normalize... <INSTR_END> ...
[decode] tokens before emit: ... <INSTR_START>  (truncated after 8 tokens)  (marker tail missing)
```

aj: That matches my suspicion. The packing reindexes slots to reduce memory, but when a block straddles a 4k boundary we serialise/deserialise and the tail segment can be dropped if truncation logic runs concurrently. The quant decode path for q4 layout v2_packed apparently doesn't detect or recover the marker split.

maria: Can we hotfix by rolling back the packing change until we fix the edge case? Also we should add a guard to avoid truncating when we detect an instruction marker near a boundary.

aj: I'll pin the canary to the previous build 5612 and run the failing cases. I'll also add a guard to the KV truncation code to avoid cutting a marker. ETA ~90m.

devon: Please re-run case 1213 and the full suite once canary is up; reproducible with seed=42 so should be quick. If rollback fixes, block v2_packed promotion and open a regression ticket.

aj: Spinning canary now. infra-bot created canary cluster canary-2026-03-19-rollback-5612.

infra-bot: canary cluster canary-2026-03-19-rollback-5612 up (3/3 nodes). Job 98766 queued.

aj: Update: canary run 98766 finished. deep_history_12k pass rate returned to 95% on the pinned build. Case 1213 shows instruction preserved. KV dumps no longer show wrap at the marker boundary.

devon: Great. I'll triage top failing cases and assemble diffs + artifacts for the regression ticket. Also add notes on how the packing interacts with slot boundaries.

sasha: While fixing, let's add a small fuzz/regression test that injects markers at each possible slot boundary and validates the round-trip after packing/unpacking under q4 decode.

maria: And add a nightly metric for "marker-drop-rate" for longctx suites so we detect this class earlier.

aj: Agreed. I'll push rollback, add the guard, and include the fuzz test in eng-ml unit tests. Will link PR and ticket here when ready.

devon: Thanks everyone. I'll open the regression ticket and attach the KV dumps + failing/passing diffs.

maria: Please post a short blameless summary in #eng-ml once the ticket and PR land. :eyes:

aj: PR linked: https://ci.internal/prs/2319 — contains rollback + guard + fuzz test.

devon: Closing the loop: canary -> rollback -> pass. Moving ticket to triage for root cause work and long-term fix for packed q4 layout.

maria: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
